decision: Existing evidence plus named reruns of the existing parent-exit and RSS-read-failure tests cover all 12 categories; no new test/business code or redundant full-suite run required.
limits: The archived lifecycle log had only an unnamed three-case summary; parent-exit and RSS-read-failure now each have a named one-case JUnit rerun; capacity already had named XML.
Full 1203 run preceded final two preflight guards; relevant final 29 cases were rerun afterwards, not another full suite.
Tests use explicit fake source/time, temporary SQLite/Parquet and SDK local loopback; these do not prove future formal daemon fault recovery.
All formal conclusions refer to archived 2026-10-17 evidence; no current daemon/sensor state was re-read in this step.
At least three distinct real trading days of automatic collection and final operational handover remain pending.
